config.label: Base URL of the MantisBT REST API, e
config.description: Base URL of the MantisBT REST API, e.g. https://your-mantis.example.com/api/rest

config.label: MantisBT API key (Profile → API Tokens in MantisBT)
config.description: MantisBT API key (Profile → API Tokens in MantisBT)

config.label: Directory for the metadata cache
config.description: Directory for the metadata cache. Defaults to ~/.cache/mantisbt-mcp

config.label: Metadata cache TTL in seconds
config.description: Metadata cache TTL in seconds. Default: 3600 (1 hour)

config.label: Transport mode
config.description: Transport mode. 'stdio' for local use (default), 'http' for remote/team deployments

config.label: Bind address when TRANSPORT=http
config.description: Bind address when TRANSPORT=http. Default: 127.0.0.1 (local only). Use 0.0.0.0 for Docker/remote.

config.label: Optional Bearer token to protect the /mcp endpoint when TRANSPORT=http
config.description: Optional Bearer token to protect the /mcp endpoint when TRANSPORT=http

config.label: Enable offline semantic search (requires ~80 MB model download on first use)
config.description: Enable offline semantic search (requires ~80 MB model download on first use)

config.label: Vector store backend for semantic search
config.description: Vector store backend for semantic search. 'vectra' (default, pure JS) or 'sqlite-vec' (faster for >10k issues)

config.label: Directory for the semantic search index
config.description: Directory for the semantic search index. Defaults to ~/.cache/mantisbt-mcp/search

config.label: Hugging Face model for embeddings
config.description: Hugging Face model for embeddings. Default: Xenova/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2

config.label: ONNX inference threads for the embedding model
config.description: ONNX inference threads for the embedding model. Default: 1

config.label: If set, restricts file uploads to this directory (path traversal protection)
config.description: If set, restricts file uploads to this directory (path traversal protection)
